label: Basil raft crop cycle (28 days) plus unit economics, Netherlands vs India
_how_to_edit: Change values under 'overrides'. Each key is a dotted path into the base file; each value replaces what is there. Keys starting with _ are comments and are ignored. Every value you add is your own assumption: note where it came from.
_farm_area_m2: Set a number (for example the grow area you are thinking of) to also see headroom for the whole farm. null = per m2 only.

_examples.feeding.feed_rate_percent_body_weight_pe: fish feed per day as % of fish weight

unit_economics._configs: Empty list = all configurations in the inputs file. Or list ids, e.g. ["E_owner_operated_dwc_basil"].

_examples.locations.netherlands.wage_per_hour: {"low": ..., "high": ...} wage per hour in that location's currency
